keyInsights.title: NRIC Reversal — Top Loser at -5.18% After Yesterday's +9.44%
keyInsights.body: NRIC gave back a large portion of yesterday's gains, falling -5.18% to 1087.10 after surging +9.44% on June 2. This sharp reversal despite remaining the second highest turnover stock at Rs.218.59M indicates profit booking following the big move.

keyInsights.title: Finance Sector Pulls Back -1.16% After Yesterday's +6.03% Surge
keyInsights.body: Finance Index declined -1.16% to 2487.07, reversing part of yesterday's massive +6.03% gain. MPFL fell -1.53% though technically remains bullish with RSI 58.74 and Aroon Up 100%. The pullback appears as healthy consolidation.

keyInsights.title: API Technically Strongest Hydro Stock — Consistent Momentum
keyInsights.body: API closed at 356.60 with RSI 58.08, ADX 31.26, and Aroon Up 85.71% — the best technical profile among hydro stocks. The ADX above 30 confirms a strong established trend. API has maintained bullish technicals across all three tracked sessions.

keyInsights.title: ULHC Deep Downtrend — ADX 45 Warning
keyInsights.body: ULHC closed at 465.50 with ADX 45.03 — the highest ADX reading among all tracked stocks — confirming a very strong downtrend. RSI 42.18 and MACD deeply bearish (-3.19/-12.68/-9.48) signal continued weakness. Avoid until clear reversal.

keyInsights.title: Market Breadth Divergence Despite Green Close
keyInsights.body: NEPSE closed green +0.09% but breadth was negative at 148 advances vs 117 declines. This divergence between price and breadth suggests the index gain was driven by heavy-weight stocks while the broader market declined. Index-level strength masking sector-level weakness.
